speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anal fissure is unlikely given the "painless" description combined with a palpable mass, which strongly raises suspicion for colorectal malignancy (e.g., rectal cancer). I am requesting an immediate Colonoscopy to visualize the mass and obtain a biopsy, along with a Complete Blood Count to assess for anemia.
